$comment: Language servers of this pack. `config` is the fragment `factory init` merges into the app repo's .factory/config.json (lsp.servers entries, see docs/code-intelligence.md for every field). `optional` holds further fragments to merge by hand. `install` says how to get each server's binary, per OS (`all` = every OS); `factory lsp setup` prints these lines for a server it cannot find. `verified` says whether this file was proven by running the server through the factory or written from the server's documentation.

verified.how: factory lsp check on a scratch module (hover, definition, references, diagnostics), gopls found through project.toolPaths.

leased.go: no for one module of ordinary size. Set "leased": true in the app repo for a large monorepo, where gopls holds the type information of every package (several GB).

all: go install golang.org/x/tools/gopls@v0.24.0   # installs to $(go env GOPATH)/bin

notes: gopls needs go.mod (or go.work) at or above the opened file; a repository with several modules and no go.work is served one module at a time.
Optional prepare: "prepare": {"command": "go", "args": ["mod", "download"], "label": "downloading modules"} (only runs for leased servers).
